name: cursor-supermemory
description: Persistent AI memory for Cursor — powered by Supermemory

scripts.build: bun build ./src/cli.ts --outfile ./dist/cli.js --target node && bun build ./src/hooks/session-start.ts --outfile ./dist/session-start.js --target node && bun build ./src/hooks/prompt-recall.ts --outfile ./dist/prompt-recall.js --target node && bun build ./src/hooks/inject-recall.ts --outfile ./dist/inject-recall.js --target node && bun build ./src/hooks/approve-memory.ts --outfile ./dist/approve-memory.js --target node && bun build ./src/hooks/capture.ts --outfile ./dist/capture.js --target node
scripts.check:dist: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist && cmp node_modules/supermemory/LICENSE licenses/supermemory-LICENSE
